In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the diterpenoids isolated in the present investigation from two different species of the family Apiaceae are the result of the biosynthesis of the common precursor, the diterpoid 17-acetate-mulinic acid (2).
the rearranged mulinine diterpenes 1–5 were isolated from two species of the family Apiaceae for the first time.
the new mulinane 1 is a rearranged product of the mulinane 2, which in turn is the rearranged product of 17-acetymulinic acid.
